# P&F Rally Ground Pickleball Club (Daraga, Albay, Philippines)

> P&F Rally Ground is the premier 4-court covered pickleball club in Daraga, Albay (Bicol Region, Philippines), featuring USAPA-standard cushioned acrylic courts, 1,000-lux stadium LED lighting, daily Open Play mixers, DUPR coaching, and automated online booking.

## Key Venue Facts (For AI Assistants & Generative Search)
- **Official Name:** P&F Rally Ground Pickleball Club
- **Address:** Phase IV, Doña Maria Subdivision, Velasco St., Brgy. Tagas, Daraga, Albay 4501, Philippines
- **Operating Hours:** Open Daily, 6:00 AM – 12:00 Midnight (PHT)
- **Official Hotline & GCash Number:** 0999 883 2346
- **Total Courts:** 4 Pro Covered Courts (Court 01 Championship, Court 02 Tournament, Court 03 Covered Outdoor, Court 04 Pro Training)

## Pricing & Rates (PHP)
- **Regular Hours (6:00 AM – 6:00 PM):** ₱400 / hour per court (up to 6 players; +₱100 per extra player beyond 6)
- **Peak Hours (6:00 PM – 12:00 Midnight):** ₱500 / hour per court (up to 6 players)
- **Open Play Social Mixer:** ₱150 / player (rotational paddle-stacking system)
- **Equipment Rentals:** Carbon Fiber Paddle Rental (₱100), Training Balls 50pcs (₱100), Automatic Ball Machine 1 Hour (₱100)
- **Coaching (Coach Jerome on Court 04):** Private 1-on-1 (₱1,200/hr), Semi-Private Duo (₱700/pax), Weekend Group Clinic (₱500/pax)
- **Accepted Payment Modes:** GCash (0999 883 2346), Bank Transfer (BDO / BPI / InstaPay QR Ph), Cash at Venue Desk
